title: Junction and Sampling Service Apron
description: One static spacebase service-apron scene using three complete qualified original models at unit scale and unchanged orientation. A full continuous three-way floor-wall-ceiling junction occupies the rear, with all three end mouths left empty; a complete twin-wing solar array occupies a separated front-left service pad and one complete fixed dual-link sampling rover is parked on the front-right ground. Every original mesh, triangle, internal node, normal buffer and per-face opaque PBR assignment remains intact. A single low scene-only ground with a straight contrasting central approach band is the only new geometry. The central front approach and separate left/right equipment zones define an outdoor service forecourt rather than a reused warehouse or a quantity variant of solar panels. One scene, zero new independent models, three complete instances of three already qualified models. No cables connect the array or vehicle; no airlock doors, astronauts, payload or operational route simulation. Static arrangement only: no generation, charging, pressure containment, flight, navigation/accessibility, docking compatibility, rover operation, structure, installation or safety claim.
